questions.question: What mathematical quantity does a Quantum Kernel circuit compute between two feature vectors x_i and x_j?
options: The state transition fidelity (inner product squared) |⟨ψ(x_i)|ψ(x_j)⟩|^2
The Euclidean distance ||x_i - x_j|| in 2D space
The sum of single-qubit measurement shot counts
questions.explanation: A quantum kernel evaluates quantum state overlap |⟨ψ(x_i)|ψ(x_j)⟩|^2 using the U†(x_j) U(x_i) sequence measured in the computational basis.

questions.question: Once the N×N quantum kernel matrix is computed, how is classification performed?
options: A classical SVM algorithm solves the standard dual optimization problem using the quantum matrix
The quantum computer automatically classifies future samples without classical intervention
The quantum circuit parameters are iteratively updated using gradient descent
The kernel matrix is inverted on quantum hardware
questions.explanation: Quantum Kernel Methods use quantum hardware strictly for kernel matrix calculation, delegating the quadratic optimization problem to a classical SVM.
